The '''Caves of Eleuabad''' were a system of submerged underground catacombs near the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was known as an area where [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]] encounters were common.<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] utilized a [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|Gungan bongo submarine]] to reach the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], venturing through the Caves of Eleuabad.<ref name="Web" />
